info.title: Banking Api
info.description: The Banking API offers secure access to customer accounts, transactions, and financial data. It enables managing funds, retrieving balances, and processing payments efficiently. This API adheres to PCI-DSS, PSD2/Open Banking, and KYC/AML compliance requirements. All requests are logged for audit purposes, and a `X-Request-ID` header is provided for tracing. The API aims for a 99.9% uptime SLA, with typical response times under 200ms, and implements rate limiting to ensure fair usage.

get.description: Provides a simple health check endpoint to indicate if the API is operational.

503.description: Service Unavailable - API is not healthy.

value.message: API is currently unhealthy or undergoing maintenance.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of customer accounts
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all bank accounts associated with the authenticated customer. Includes account details such as balance, type, and status.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter accounts by their current status.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific account
get.description: Fetches the detailed information for a single bank account identified by its unique `accountRef`.

get.summary: Retrieve transactions for a specific account
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of financial transactions associated with a given account. Filters can be applied by transaction type or status.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter transactions by their current status.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for transaction filtering (ISO 8601 format).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for transaction filtering (ISO 8601 format).

transactions.description: List of transactions for the specified account.

post.description: Initiates a new transaction, such as a transfer between accounts or a payment. This endpoint supports idempotency via the `Idempotency-Key` header.

requestBody.description: Details for the transaction to be initiated.

201.description: Transaction initiated successfully. The transaction status will initially be PENDING.

value.message: Transaction initiated successfully. Status is PENDING.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a specific transaction
get.description: Fetches the current status and details of a financial transaction using its unique `transactionId`.

post.description: Initiates a new payment from a customer's account to a beneficiary. This endpoint requires Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) and supports idempotency via the `Idempotency-Key` header.

requestBody.description: Details for the payment to be initiated.

201.description: Payment initiated successfully. Awaiting SCA confirmation.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of customer cards
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all debit and credit cards associated with the authenticated customer. Card numbers are masked for PCI-DSS compliance.

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter cards by their current status.

post.description: Blocks a customer's card, typically due to loss, theft, or suspicious activity. This action is irreversible through this endpoint.

parameters.name: cardRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the card to be blocked.

reason.description: The reason for blocking the card.

notes.description: Additional notes regarding the card block.

value.message: Card CARD-111122223333 has been successfully blocked.

patch.summary: Update the status or limits of a specific card
patch.description: Updates the status of a customer's card (e.g., unblocking a card) or modifies its spending limits. This endpoint supports partial updates.

parameters.name: cardRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the card to be updated.

statusCode.description: The new status for the card.

dailyLimitAmount.description: New daily spending limit for the card.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the daily limit.

value.message: Card CARD-111122223333 status updated to ACTIVE.

sourceAccountRef.description: Reference to the source account for the transaction.

destinationAccountRef.description: Reference to the destination account (if applicable).

totalAmount.description: Total amount of the transaction. Negative for debits, positive for credits.

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the transaction occurred or was initiated.

InitiateTransactionRequest.description: Request body for initiating a new transaction.

sourceAccountRef.description: Reference to the source account for the transaction.

destinationAccountRef.description: Reference to the destination account (if applicable, e.g., for transfers).

merchantName.description: Name of the merchant (if applicable, e.g., for payments).

transactionId.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction.

sourceAccountRef.description: Reference to the source account for the payment.

beneficiaryBankCode.description: Bank identifier code (e.g., SWIFT/BIC) of the beneficiary's bank.

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the payment was initiated.

InitiatePaymentRequest.description: Request body for initiating a new payment.

sourceAccountRef.description: Reference to the source account for the payment.

beneficiaryBankCode.description: Bank identifier code (e.g., SWIFT/BIC) of the beneficiary's bank.

Card.description: Represents a customer's debit or credit card.

dailyLimitAmount.description: Daily spending limit for the card.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the daily limit.

StandardResponseEnvelope.description: Standard API response envelope for consistent output.

statusCode.description: Status code of the API operation (e.g., SUCCESS, FAILED).

message.description: A human-readable message describing the outcome.

field.description: The field that caused the error (if applicable).

details.description: Optional array of detailed error messages, typically for validation errors.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page.

offset.description: Number of items skipped from the beginning.

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

OffsetParam.name: offset

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: A unique key to ensure that a request is processed only once. This helps prevent duplicate transactions.

XRequestIDHeader.name: X-Request-ID
XRequestIDHeader.description: Unique identifier for the request, used for tracing and debugging. If not provided, the server will generate one.

XRateLimitLimit.description: The maximum number of requests that the client is permitted to make per hour.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current rate limit window.

XRateLimitReset.description: The time at which the current rate limit window resets in UTC epoch seconds.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - The request was malformed or invalid.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials were missing or invalid.

value.message: Authentication token is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden - The authenticated user does not have the necessary permissions.

value.message: Insufficient permissions to perform this action.

NotFound.description: Not Found - The requested resource could not be found.

value.message: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: Conflict - The request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource (e.g., idempotency key reuse).

value.message: Idempotency key already used for a different request or transaction is already in progress.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error - An unexpected error occurred on the server.

value.message: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
